cases.expected: append /dir/f.txt to the root .gitignore and keep the edit unstaged; Git still reports dir/f.txt untracked; preserve the selected file, nested .gitignore, and index

cases.expected: preserve the external edit; append safely against fresh content or refuse without overwriting it

cases.expected: refuse; link target, index and f unchanged

cases.expected: unavailable; f and index unchanged

cases.expected: refuse; unmerged entries and worktree bytes unchanged

cases.expected: new shared stash contains A f,g,h; A i stays; B j unchanged; A tracked changes clean and h absent

cases.expected: new returns untracked; f restored unstaged; g index preserved; remove O only; N remains

cases.action: open Pop Latest… and confirm N and the destination without a picker

cases.given: shared stash list empty
cases.expected: unavailable; no writes

cases.expected: if the confirmed selection no longer matches, do not dispatch pop; explain and refresh without changing the observed Git state

cases.given: two stash entries have identical object IDs
cases.expected: if entry identity cannot be distinguished safely, refuse and retain both

cases.given: stash O modifies f; destination has overlapping incompatible f change
cases.expected: report actual Git state; retain O; preserve unrelated index and files; no automatic retry

cases.given: confirmed O passes final revalidation; external Git changes the stash list after native pop is dispatched and attribution is uncertain
cases.action: observe the result of one native pop
cases.expected: refresh and report actual worktree and stash state without claiming exact consumption; no separate drop, reflog rewrite, automatic retry, or Apply fallback

cases.given: index lock exists; f is dirty
cases.expected: report failure; preserve f, existing index and lock; refresh status

cases.expected: never act on B; revalidate A or refuse; B unchanged
